يرتكبون (form VIII)
# يَرْتَكِبُونَ (yartakibūna) /jar.ta.ki.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# يُرْتَكَبُونَ (yurtakabūna) /jur.ta.ka.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
